## Featured projects

| Project | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **[VTECSeg](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/VTECseg)** | Hybrid CNN/vision-transformer crack segmentation; published in *Automation in Construction*. |
| **[UsherScan](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/usherscan-showcase)** | Offline, on-device AI crack inspection for mobile. [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.usherscan.crackdetection) |
| **[StructAgent](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/StructAgent-LLM-structural-design-analysis)** | LLM agents and interactive 3D modeling for structural analysis with OpenSeesPy. [Live demo](https://structagent.oscarp.com.np) |
| **[ROS-LM](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/LLM_ROS2_agent)** | Natural-language control, navigation, and vision tools for ROS 2 robots. |
| **[BuildBIM](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/buildBIM)** | Parametric BIM authoring with plans, sections, schedules, and clash checks. |
| **[BIM IFC Toolkit](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/BIM_IFC_Toolkit)** | IFC visualization, IFC/JSON conversion, and semantic graph generation. |
| **[Construction Multi-Agent AI](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/multiagent_LLM_for_construction)** | Vision analysis, retrieval, monitoring, and documented construction workflows. |
| **[Quest VR Teleoperation](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/meta_quest_teleop_with_VR_SCREEN)** | VR camera overlay and bidirectional controller/camera streaming for teleoperation. |
| **[ROS 2 + YOLOv8](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/turtlebot_3_ROSnav2__yolov8)** | Robot object detection with location context and Qdrant memory. |
| **[Gaze-Assisted UAV](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/Eye-Tracking-drone-control)** | Eye-tracking-based Crazyflie navigation in Webots. |
| **[ETABS Automation](https://github.com/oscarpoudel/automate-etabs-batch-run-and-analysis)** | Batch execution and extraction of structural analysis results. |
